description: Create a new player profile (POST /profile). IMPORTANT: per the Panda API, `name` MUST be the ID of an existing video — if it is not a real video ID the API returns 500 and nothing is created. Create only accepts `name` and `exclusive`; it does NOT accept colors/controls/vsl. To set those, call panda_update_profile with the returned profile id afterward. Returns {data: {id, name}}.

exclusive.description: Optional. True = dedicated/restricted to a single video

name.description: MUST be the ID of an existing video (the profile is created for that video)

name: panda_create_profile
title: Create Profile
